decisions.reason: A niche agricultural reusable crate fits the firm's returnable packaging portfolio, and one year is too early to withdraw it despite its limited web presence.
The foldable large container has its own dedicated page, signalling a strategic core product with strong logistics demand.
Stackable crates are a staple product line for large plastic packaging makers and are cheap to keep in the range.
A medium-duty rackable pallet fills a standard gap in the pallet range and sells to existing customers.
The spill-retention pallet serves regulated demand for hazardous material storage and is featured on its own page.
The pallet with load retainers is a specialized, prominently presented product with steady industrial applications.
